summary: First-round backend-only testing for Tredways. Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering 21 test cases across health, chart-data, SMC analyze (RELIANCE/EURUSD/BTCUSD/XAUUSD/NIFTY), stock/forex/scalp analyze proxies, angel-price fallback, scanner, and symbol normalization. All 21 tests passed (100%). Data-quality spot checks confirm valid JSON payloads with expected fields (current_phase, zones[], liquidity_grab{direction,grade,reasons}, atr, last_price, candles OHLC+timestamp, live_price, signal_type/status_label/entry/sl/tp). Node backend health reports ok; python->node proxy path is working through Kubernetes ingress. Angel is correctly stubbed and falls back to Yahoo as expected.

minor.issue: current_phase came back NEUTRAL for all 5 tested pairs during off-hours; phase detection heuristic may be too strict (accumulation range < 2*ATR + explicit manipulation false-breakout). Zones/FVGs/OBs are populated correctly, so this is acceptable but worth verifying during market hours.

reason_summary reports 'WEAK VOLUME: 0.0x avg' — volume feed from Yahoo can be 0 on FX/crypto/off-hours which permanently trips the trap-detection filter and forces WAIT. Consider skipping the volume-trap check for FX/crypto or when volume==0.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: relax SMC phase heuristic or expose thresholds via env so phases populate more often.
Optional: bypass volume-trap check in node analyze when instrument has no reliable volume (FX/crypto/off-hours).
Optional: expose /api/stats through node backend — not tested here since not listed in review request.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: LiquidityGrabSignal.rr calculation uses `risk and (abs(tp2-entry)/risk)` — if risk==0 rr becomes 0 (falsy short-circuit) which is fine, but round(0,2) is valid; still, a division safety comment would help future maintainers.

server.py: /api/chart-data returns HTTPException with status 404 on missing data — good; but /api/smc-analyze uses same 404 for 'insufficient data' which could be confused with symbol-not-found. Consider 422.

smc_engine.py detect_phases loops from n-200 → n-window and keeps overwriting best_acc, effectively returning the LAST qualifying window. Naming best_acc is misleading — it isn't optimized, just the most recent. Rename to last_acc for clarity.
smc_engine.py: swing detection uses lookback=3 which is fine for 15m but may be noisy on 1m and too coarse on 1d. Consider adaptive lookback per timeframe.

server.py: CORS uses os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS','*').split(',') with allow_credentials=True — combining '*' with credentials is invalid per CORS spec and browsers will reject. Set explicit origins in prod.
